title: The Grapes of Wrath
author: John Steinbeck
description: The Joad family loses their Oklahoma farm in the Dust Bowl and drives west to California, where the promised work turns out to be a trap.
reasons: want a big, angry, humane novel about ordinary people being ground down
care about where the American dream breaks
like family sagas where the road itself is a character
want prose that slows down and looks hard at land and weather
